cards.card_text: And in case you were wondering, an omer is a tenth of an ephah.
cards.verse_text: (Now an omer is a tenth of an ephah.)
cards.snippet: (Now an omer is a tenth of an ephah.)

cards.card_text: And if he can't afford two birds either, he may bring a tenth of an ephah of fine flour as a sin offering.
cards.verse_text: But if he cannot afford two turtledoves or two young pigeons, he may bring a tenth of an ephah of fine flour as a sin offering.
cards.snippet: …turtledoves or two young pigeons, he may bring a tenth of an ephah of fine flour as a sin offering.

cards.card_text: God wants honest ___ and weights, plus an honest ephah and an honest hin.
cards.verse_text: You shall maintain honest scales and weights, an honest ephah, and an honest hin.
cards.snippet: You shall maintain honest scales and weights, an honest ephah, and an honest hin.

cards.card_text: Next, the LORD tells Moses to take fine flour and bake twelve loaves, two-tenths of an ephah for each loaf.
cards.verse_text: You are also to take fine flour and bake twelve loaves, using two-tenths of an ephah for each loaf,
cards.snippet: …to take fine flour and bake twelve loaves, using two-tenths of an ephah for each loaf,

cards.card_text: He brings an offering for her too, a tenth of an ephah.
cards.verse_text: He must also bring for her an offering of a tenth of an ephah of barley flour.
cards.snippet: …must also bring for her an offering of a tenth of an ephah of barley flour.

cards.card_text: When Ruth beats out her grain, it comes to about an ephah of ___.
cards.verse_text: And when she beat out what she had gleaned, it was about an ephah of barley.
cards.snippet: …when she beat out what she had gleaned, it was about an ephah of barley.

cards.card_text: Then, though he's still young, she takes him to the house of the LORD at Shiloh with a three-year-old bull, an ephah of flour and a skin of wine.
cards.verse_text: Once she had weaned him, Hannah took the boy with her, along with a three-year-old bull, an ephah of flour, and a skin of wine.
cards.snippet: …Hannah took the boy with her, along with a three-year-old bull, an ephah of flour, and a skin of wine.

cards.card_text: A homer of seed will yield only an ephah of grain.
cards.verse_text: For ten acres of vineyard will yield but a bath of wine, and a homer of seed only an ephah of grain.”
cards.snippet: …but a bath of wine, and a homer of seed only an ephah of grain.”

cards.card_text: Then caravans of camels will cover the land, young camels of Midian and Ephah, two desert peoples.
cards.verse_text: Caravans of camels will cover your land, young camels of Midian and Ephah, and all from Sheba will come, bearing gold and frankincense and proclaiming the praises of the LORD.
cards.snippet: Caravans of camels will cover your land, young camels of Midian and Ephah, and all from Sheba will come, bearing gold and frankincense and proclaiming…

cards.card_text: Next, God says to use ___ scales, along with a just ephah and a just bath.
cards.verse_text: You must use honest scales, a just ephah, and a just bath.
cards.snippet: You must use honest scales, a just ephah, and a just bath.

cards.card_text: On top of that comes a grain offering: an ephah for each bull and each ram, with a hin of olive oil for each ephah.
cards.verse_text: He shall also provide as a grain offering an ephah for each bull and an ephah for each ram, along with a hin of olive oil for each ephah of grain.
cards.snippet: He shall also provide as a grain offering an ephah for each bull and an ephah for each ram, along with a…

cards.card_text: Their plan is to reduce the ephah and increase the shekel, which means less grain for more money.
cards.verse_text: Let us reduce the ephah and increase the shekel; let us cheat with dishonest scales.
cards.snippet: Let us reduce the ephah and increase the shekel; let us cheat with dishonest scales.

cards.card_text: Along with shrinking the ephah and raising the shekel, these people plan to cheat with dishonest scales.
cards.verse_text: Let us reduce the ephah and increase the shekel; let us cheat with dishonest scales.
cards.snippet: Let us reduce the ephah and increase the shekel; let us cheat with dishonest scales.

cards.card_text: He asks, "Can I forget any longer, O house of the wicked, the treasures of wickedness and the short ephah, which is accursed?"
cards.verse_text: Can I forget any longer, O house of the wicked, the treasures of wickedness and the short ephah, which is accursed?
cards.snippet: …O house of the wicked, the treasures of wickedness and the short ephah, which is accursed?

cards.card_text: Back before the temple work began, someone came expecting a heap of twenty ephahs of grain.
cards.verse_text: from that time, when one came expecting a heap of twenty ephahs of grain, there were but ten.
cards.snippet: from that time, when one came expecting a heap of twenty ephahs of grain, there were but ten.
